name: Los Molares (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Los Molares (a castle and lions on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Los Molares; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Los Molares arms — castle and lions on white and red
